sections.description: FutureLabs AI SEO is an indexing-first SEO plugin. It helps site owners find and remove common blockers to indexing and highlights pages that look thin, duplicated or hard to reach. It is built for busy publishing sites with many authors and time-limited content such as scholarships, grants, jobs and events.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Fixed: category pages (and any page whose meta description is longer than 160 characters) crashed with a critical error on hosts whose PHP has no mbstring extension. Descriptions are now shortened with functions WordPress always provides.
  • Fixed: a few other calls relied on PHP's optional ctype extension; they no longer do.
  • Changed: if the plugin's head tags ever fail, the page now loads without them instead of showing a critical error.

1.4.1

  • New: a public, read-only feed of open opportunities and their eligibility at /wp-json/flseo/v1/opportunities/feed, so a reader-matching service can use them without a WordPress login. It's available only while eligibility fields are on and lists only what readers already see on each post.

1.4.0

  • New: optional features. Under Settings → Features & publishing you can switch opportunity publishing (deadline and status fields, deadline badges, the Opportunities screen and the daily expiry job), publishing pace warnings and the new eligibility fields on or off. They start off on new installs. Sites that already use them keep them on after updating, with nothing to set up.
  • New: the publishing checklist can be off, soft (advice only) or required (blocks publishing), and you can choose which checks run, for example keeping the meta description check but dropping "at least 2 internal links".
  • New: eligibility fields for opportunities (optional): eligible countries (ISO codes, with AFRICA and ALL shortcuts), whether the country rule is about citizenship or residence, age range, gender, education or career level, field, minimum experience, business stage, and opportunity type, format and funding. They're stored as machine-readable post meta so another service can match readers to opportunities.
  • Changed: turning a feature off hides it but keeps its data.

1.3.0

  • New: works with the NewsDesk theme (NewsTheme renamed for WordPress.org). Deadline badges, the "Closing soon" block and breadcrumbs keep working after switching to NewsDesk.
  • New: extension points for add-ons such as FutureLabs AI SEO Pro (settings, admin screens, settings tabs, dashboard sections; see docs/HOOKS.md). Nothing changes for existing users.
  • Moved to FutureLabs AI SEO Pro: the Reports screen (email digests, refresh list, query ideas, competing pages and Core Web Vitals / PageSpeed tests) and its PageSpeed and Reports settings. The dashboard's indexed-over-time chart stays in the free plugin. Saved settings, keys, schedules and data are kept, and Pro uses them as they are.

1.2.9

  • Changed: the checklist item for internal links now needs links to at least 2 other posts or pages. Category, tag and home page links no longer count, since they don't give other posts inbound links.
